title: feat(ui,app): an async file picker opens models and projects in the browser
body:
Part of #31, the app and UI on wasm. This slice adds an **async file picker**, so a model or a project can be opened in the browser build. Until now every picker there answered "cancelled".

Fork synced at v0.18.0. The branch merges `upstream/main` (53a52f88) so that it diffs clean against `main`.

## What changed
- **`crates/ui/src/file_pick.rs`** (new): the browser picker. On wasm32, `open()` makes an `<input type=file>` whose `accept` comes from the dialog's filters, clicks it and returns at once. When the user has chosen, the file's name and bytes go into a thread-local inbox, and the next frame is woken through the egui context, which `shell_web` registers.
  - Files over 256 MiB (`BROWSER_READ_LIMIT`) are refused by name before they are read. A failed allocation in wasm aborts the tab.
  - The input and its change closure are held in one slot until the next pick, not `forget`ed, so a cancelled picker does not leak.
  - The inbox, `accept_attr` and `too_big` are plain Rust on every target.
- **`crates/ui/src/state_picked.rs`** (new):
  - `open_model_dialog` / `open_project_dialog`: rfd's synchronous dialog on native (unchanged), the async picker on wasm32.
  - Each frame, `drain_actions` turns every inbox entry into a `CommandKind::OpenPicked`. A model goes through `ImportModel::from_bytes` and `finish_import`: one undo step, and a same-named model is an update. A project goes through `project::open_noted`.
  - A failed read, a refused import, or a project that is not text or not JSON is said on the status line ("import refused: …" / "open failed: …") and changes nothing.
- **`crates/app/src/commands/import_model.rs`**: `ImportModel::from_bytes(file_name, data, budget)`. It shares the path import's laws through `checked_budget`: IGES and unknown extensions refused, the STEP budget's bounds. It adds the `MAX_FILE_BYTES` cap and the finite-mesh gate. `geometry::import::parse_model_graded_within` is now `pub`.
- **`crates/ui/src/state.rs`**:
  - Two new `CommandKind` arms route to the functions above.
  - The model and project dialogs' filters are factored out (`mesh_dialog`, `project_dialog`) so both pickers ask with the same ones.
  - `open_project_path`'s reset is factored out as `reset_for_open`, so the bytes open retires the old document the same way. Behaviour is unchanged.
- No dependency added. The picker uses `eframe::web_sys` features that eframe already enables (`HtmlInputElement`, `File`, `FileList`, `Blob`).
- **Safari fix (after the user's hand check, 2026-11-13).** `State::run_click_actions` runs the queue at the end of the clicked frame when it holds an action that may open a chooser (Open model, Open project, the unsaved-changes answer). eframe runs that frame inside its `pointerup` listener, so `input.click()` now happens inside the user's click; before, the queue ran at the start of the next frame, from requestAnimationFrame, where Safari ignores it without a word. The hidden input is now attached to the page with `display:none` and removed when replaced. A chooser asked for from the Cmd/Ctrl+O shortcut (a later frame) says on the status line to click File > Model / File > Open if no chooser appeared.
- The browser build no longer starts with "no theme folder found beside the exe" (`theme_dir::startup_status`).
- **Merge with #1431 (main):** main refused Open model / Open project in the browser until this picker landed; `browser_files::refusal` no longer refuses them, `NEEDS_PICKER` now names the pickers still owed, and the #1431 tests assert the two cells live.
- Decisions: `docs/decisions/31-wasm-file-picker.md`.

## How tested
- Pinning tests:
  - `crates/app/tests/import_bytes.rs`:
    - `picked_bytes_import_like_the_same_file_from_disk`: the same name, mesh and fidelity as the disk import, for STL, OBJ and STEP.
    - `picked_bytes_are_refused_by_name_never_a_panic`: IGES, an unknown extension, no extension, empty or corrupt files of each format, and a budget given for a non-STEP file.
  - `crates/ui/src/file_pick_tests.rs`:
    - `a_picked_model_imports_through_the_undoable_command`
    - `a_picked_file_that_cannot_be_used_is_refused_by_name`
    - `a_picked_project_opens_in_place_of_the_document`
    - `the_browser_picker_accepts_the_dialogs_extensions`
    - `a_file_over_the_browser_read_limit_is_refused_before_it_is_read`
    - `a_chooser_asked_for_by_a_click_opens_inside_that_click` (Safari fix)
    - `a_chooser_outside_a_click_says_what_to_do_instead_of_failing_silently` (Safari fix)
  - `theme_dir::tests::the_browser_build_never_says_a_theme_folder_is_missing_beside_an_exe`
  - `browser_files::tests::every_picker_and_folder_command_is_refused_by_name_in_the_browser`, `egui_app::tests::browser_files::{the_ribbon_keeps_open_live_in_the_browser, a_picker_the_browser_lacks_is_refused_by_name_not_ignored}` (merge with #1431)
- **Safari fix push (head 0dd7eebc, merges upstream/main f84059c9):** `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` green (app suites 69 s, ui suites 67 s); `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean; `web/build-app-wasm.sh --release` built with no camcraft warnings (stock macOS bash now runs it) and `web/check-app-page.sh target/web` passed. A plain `cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` is not possible here: flecs' C needs the script's wasi sysroot.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green. The app suites (lib, import_bytes, large_models, model_fidelity, step_*, stock_export, bore_facet_sagitta) passed in 21 s. The ui suites (lib, boundary, boundary_picks, feedback, fixtures, gpu_render, machine, models, operations, shell, theme_files) passed in 19 s.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean (native, macOS).
- **wasm check**: `web/build-app-wasm.sh` passed on macOS, using the official rustc 1.99.1 with the wasm32 std and Homebrew LLVM's clang for the wasi C.
  - It linked `camcraft-cli.wasm` and `camcraft_ui.wasm`, ran wasm-bindgen 0.2.129 and laid out `target/web`. The shim answers all nine WASI imports.
  - camcraft-ui raised no warnings.
  - `web/check-app-page.sh target/web` passed.
  - The script needed two local workarounds, which are not part of this PR: a GNU-`sed -i` shim, and a bash-3.2 empty-array fix for `"${PROFILE_ARGS[@]}"` under `set -u` (line 104). As shipped, the script does not run on stock macOS bash/sed. Worth a small follow-up.

## Not exercised - browser hand check needed
- **The picker was not run in a browser.** It needs a hand check: serve `target/web`, then use File > Open model on an STL, OBJ and STEP file and File > Open project on a `.camproj`. Also check that cancel does nothing and that a file over 256 MiB is refused on the status line.
- **Safari fix verified by hand by the user on 2026-11-14 (build 32c66876 = 0dd7eebc tree).** The user's hand check (2026-11-13) passed in Chrome and Brave; in Safari, File > Open model opened no chooser and said nothing. The input was clicked from the next egui frame (requestAnimationFrame), outside the click; Safari ignores it there. It is now clicked at the end of the clicked frame, which eframe runs inside its `pointerup` listener (see the PR comment for the sources). The Cmd/Ctrl+O shortcut is still handed over on a later frame: in Safari it may not open the chooser, and the status line then says to click File > Model / File > Open.
- Still owed on #31 (see the decisions file):
  - The other pickers: fixture import, machine, post, theme and tool library.
  - Dropped files.
  - Inline playback, a WebGPU run, the in-browser CI job, console diagnostics for the app crate, and the shell.rs split.

Changelog: The browser build opens models (STL, OBJ, STEP) and projects through an async file picker (#31).
Effort: high (no escalation)

Refs #31
